mechanism: Betamethasone may increase valganciclovir levels through competition for renal tubular secretion and enhance immunosuppression risk; valganciclovir can potentiate corticosteroid-induced hyperglycemia and electrolyte abnormalities.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and glucose levels closely; adjust valganciclovir dosing if renal impairment develops; use lowest effective betamethasone dose for shortest duration.
